CustomField.description: Field populated via flow automation each time the person is moved to MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead) Person Status. SAL-4910.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the date and time the person most recently MQL'd. The primary difference between this field and the existing MQL Date Time field is that the MQL Date Time is the first time the person MQL'd vs this field which is the most recent time the person MQL'd.
CustomField.label: Most Recent MQL Date Time
